name: gigradar
description: Operate a GigRadar account from your agent: configure Upwork job scanners, search the live job market, read per-scanner performance (PVR, LRR, connects), and manage CRM conversations.

interface.shortDescription: Upwork lead generation, scanners and CRM, run from your agent.
interface.longDescription: GigRadar watches Upwork for jobs matching your saved searches and can send proposals automatically. This plugin bundles the hosted MCP server with the skill that teaches an agent to scope a scanner that neither starves nor floods, read its PVR and LRR honestly, and confirm before anything spends connects.
defaultPrompt: Show me my GigRadar scanners and how each performed over the last month
Set up a scanner for senior React jobs from payment-verified US clients, but skip WordPress
Has demand for my niche declined this year?
